_: M45b actor seed. Actor is global; vision/capability assignments are per-vision M2M joins. Adding entries here populates the Hero Actors band + capability card 'Active actors' footer + /visions/[slug]/actors/[key] detail pages. Signal extractor agent (M39+M45b) matches Signal.actor_id against actor.signal_keywords per-vision when confidence > 0.8.

actors.name: SpaceX
actors.blurb: Cheap launch + Starship — sets the orbital DC capex floor.
actors.description: SpaceX operates Falcon 9 (reusable medium-lift) and is developing Starship (super-heavy, fully reusable). Its $/kg-to-LEO curve is the primary cost lever for orbital data centers.

actors.name: Lonestar Data Holdings
actors.blurb: Orbital DC payload startup; Series B 2026.
actors.description: First-mover commercial orbital DC operator; lunar + LEO demos planned for 2027.

actors.name: Starcloud
actors.blurb: 1kW orbital heat-rejection demo (2025); scaling to 100kW.
actors.description: Early-stage in-orbit thermal radiator demonstrator. Only commercial actor with proven in-orbit thermal demo at meaningful scale.

actors.name: Advanced Micro Devices
actors.blurb: GPU competitor; MI300 rad-qual in flight.
actors.description: GPU and CPU manufacturer pursuing radiation qualification of the MI300 family at NASA Pegasus. Outcome gates orbital training workloads.

actors.name: NVIDIA
actors.blurb: Dominant ground GPU player; orbital rad-tolerance roadmap pending.
actors.description: Dominant AI accelerator supplier. Orbital rad-tolerance announcement would materially shift the binding capability.

actors.name: Intel
actors.blurb: Foundry + accelerator competitor; rad-hard SoC programs.
actors.description: Intel Foundry Services + Gaudi/Ponte Vecchio accelerator lines. Some rad-hard SoC work via Altera.

actors.name: Cobham Microelectronics
actors.blurb: Radiation-hardened microelectronics specialist.
actors.description: Lead supplier of rad-hard ICs, FPGAs, and memory to space programs. The default vendor for rad-tolerant logic.

actors.name: Mynaric
actors.blurb: Optical comms terminals — Tbps-class downlink shipping.
actors.description: Volume optical terminal supplier; lead actor on downlink capability.

actors.name: NASA
actors.blurb: OSAM-1 assembly + Pegasus rad-qual facility.
actors.description: Anchor lab for in-orbit assembly + radiation testing. OSAM-1 demonstrator delays directly affect assembly score.

actors.name: European Space Agency
actors.blurb: Optical comms + radiator R&D + payload programs.
actors.description: Active across downlink + thermal capabilities; lab-scale demos feed commercial pipeline.

actors.name: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency
actors.blurb: Optical comms milestone partner.
actors.description: Active on optical downlink demonstrations; Hayabusa heritage useful for in-orbit thermal.

actors.name: Jet Propulsion Laboratory
actors.blurb: Thermal control flagship lab.
actors.description: Caltech-operated FFRDC. Long history of in-orbit thermal control technology development.

actors.name: Redwire Space (Made In Space)
actors.blurb: In-orbit manufacturing + assembly competitor to OSAM-1.
actors.description: Acquired Made In Space; pursues commercial OSAM (on-orbit servicing, assembly, manufacturing).

actors.name: Northrop Grumman
actors.blurb: MEV satellite servicing competitor.
actors.description: Operates MEV (Mission Extension Vehicle) servicing program. Adjacent to in-orbit assembly capability.

actors.name: Lloyd's of London
actors.blurb: Orbital insurance market hub — $2B/y aggregate cap.
actors.description: Insurance market that underwrites the majority of orbital programs. Underwriting depth caps project size.

actors.name: AXA XL Space Insurance
actors.blurb: Second-tier orbital underwriter.
actors.description: Continental European orbital insurance carrier; rare among non-Lloyd's writers.

actors.name: International Telecommunication Union
actors.blurb: Spectrum coordination for Ka/Q-band orbital links.
actors.description: UN body that allocates orbital spectrum + slots. Ka/Q-band largely settled; per-constellation coordination ongoing.

actors.name: US Federal Communications Commission
actors.blurb: US spectrum + orbital licensing regulator.
actors.description: Issues US spectrum licenses + orbital debris mitigation rules.

actors.name: Uptime Institute
actors.blurb: Tier-N reliability certification authority for data centers.
actors.description: Sets Tier-I through Tier-IV reliability standards for terrestrial DCs; orbital adaptation pending.

actors.name: SolAero Technologies
actors.blurb: Space-grade solar cells (acquired by Rocket Lab).
actors.description: Premier US space solar cell manufacturer; now part of Rocket Lab.

actors.name: Maxar Technologies
actors.blurb: Satellite buses + Earth observation incumbent.
actors.description: Largest US commercial satellite bus supplier. Power systems + integration depth.

actors.name: Rocket Lab
actors.blurb: Small-lift competitor; Neutron medium-lift in development.
actors.description: Electron (small-lift) operational; Neutron under development as a medium-lift reusable competitor.

actors.name: Blue Origin
actors.blurb: New Glenn heavy-lift competitor.
actors.description: New Glenn heavy-lift reusable; lunar Blue Moon lander program.
